summary: Full-extraction pass over 20 international documents (European Commission reports on investor citizenship and residence schemes, visa-suspension-mechanism reports and staff working documents, press releases, the Commission recommendation of March 2022, the CJEU judgment and AG opinion in C-181/23, and two Canada visa notices). New rows cover every country these documents give numbers for: Montenegro, North Macedonia, Moldova, Vanuatu, the five Eastern Caribbean programmes, Hungary, Serbia, and investor-programme rules for Bulgaria, Cyprus, Croatia, Ireland, Netherlands, Portugal, UK; plus events for Cyprus, Malta, Vanuatu and adoption years for six EU residence schemes. Where the same report was stored under a country id (mlt-ec-com-2019-12, grc-eu-com-2019-12, grd-eu-vsm8-2025, mlt-cjeu-c181-23, mlt-ec-ip-20-1925), the items earlier passes left to the INTL copy are taken here.
